description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Wolverine Trading is a diversified financial institution specializing in proprietary trading and technology solutions. They are seeking a Software Engineer to join their team, focusing on full-stack development of desktop applications and solving business problems with technology.
C# .NET desktop application developer for financial trading systems with SQL Server support

Responsibilities:
• Perform full-stack development of primarily desktop applications using .NET technologies and SQL Server, working alongside developers and traders in a dynamic environment
• Design, develop, and support applications that solve real business problems, applying strong troubleshooting skills to resolve software issues
• Implement and uphold best practices for software engineering policies and procedures

Requirements:
• A bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering (or equivalent practical experience)
• Working knowledge of an object-oriented language such as C# or Java
• Experience with SQL Server or a comparable relational database
• A solid grasp of software development methodologies
• Experience in requirements gathering, testing, and implementation from both technical and business perspectives
• A proactive, self-motivated problem solver who thrives on a team
• Ability to contribute confidently in planning sessions
• Focus on the end-user experience

Preferred:
• Experience with WPF and/or Windows Forms
